name: qlrisk_price_fx_swap
title: Price a FXSwap
description:
Price one FX Swap - spot + forward transaction (qlrisk FXSwap).
Inputs (* required, name=default): base_notional*, near_settlement*, far_settlement*, base_currency*, quote_currency*, near_rate*, far_rate*. In `advanced` also: buy_base_near.
Example: {"base_notional": 1000000, "near_settlement": "3M", "far_settlement": "1Y", "base_currency": "EUR", "quote_currency": "USD", "near_rate": 1.1, "far_rate": 1.11} gives NPV 5,000.00 USD (sample market valued 2026-10-09).
